notes: One entry per round of the TA-indicator strategy study (packages/ml-engine/src/ta_strategy, docs/ta-strategy-600-ticks.md). A round is a grid: every timeframe x horizon x model is fitted once per walk-forward fold, and every trading rule is scored on those out-of-sample probabilities. After each round a review reads the landed tables and its recommendations become the next round's entry here.

1.title: Baseline: the full TA battery, made honest
1.hypothesis: With the conviction gate fitted on validation rows, next-open fills, roll back-adjustment and one cost basis, the TA battery's best configurations earn less than the 20-64 ticks per day logged in July, and far below 600.

2.title: Round-1 review applied: centred gate, alpha scoring, logistic only
2.hypothesis: Round 1's best results were buy-and-hold beta: the gate measured |P - 0.5| while the models centre on the market's upward drift (P ~ 0.55), so 'high conviction' meant 'long'. Centring the gate on each fold's fit-row mean P and scoring alpha after beta will show whether any TA-direction edge exists at all. Pre-registered primary: 1h, 12-bar hold, logistic C=0.05, centred gate 10% (round 1's best cell with the gate fixed). It passes only if its alpha has a Newey-West t >= 2, the grid-wide Reality Check p <= 0.05 and alpha is positive in at least 7 of 9 folds. Expected: it does not pass, and no configuration nears 600.
